description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pitunugama, Udunuwara,  D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No.320242 (24/0262).
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (Plot 139, Block 02) in Kandy District, including details about the land extent, owner information, and title classification. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns property ownership, land titles, and land registration matters.
